summary: StaffConsentForms is a module for managing staff consent forms in the HSPnet system. It supports searching, adding, updating, and deleting consent forms for staff, with various fields and business rules enforced. The module operates through database procedures and validates key fields before actions.
purpose: To store, retrieve, update, and delete staff consent form records, tracking provider, agency, and consent information for compliance and operational requirements.

workflows.name: Search Staff Consent Forms (by StaffID)
steps: Add StaffID and SessionID as parameters.
Iterate over returned records, fill StaffConsentForm list.

workflows.name: Search Staff Consent Forms (by ID)
steps: Add ID as parameter (only if ID > 0).
Iterate over returned records, fill StaffConsentForm list.

workflows.name: Add Staff Consent Form
steps: Parse AgencyID and ProviderID from ProviderListDept.
If valid, set procedure name to StaffConsentFormsAdd.
Add SessionID, StaffID, AgencyID, ProviderID, DateReceived, ProviderTypeCodeID, Notes as parameters.

workflows.name: Update Staff Consent Form
steps: Parse AgencyID and ProviderID from ProviderListDept.
If valid, set procedure name to StaffConsentFormsUpdate.
Add SessionID, ID, AgencyID, ProviderID, DateReceived, ProviderTypeCodeID, Notes as parameters.

workflows.name: Delete Staff Consent Form
steps: Add SessionID and ID as parameters.

business_rules: Do not run search by ID if ID <= 0.
DateReceived is mandatory; cannot be null.
AgencyID and ProviderID must be parsed from ProviderListDept field.
validations: IsValid() method checks DateReceived and adds error message if missing.
calculations: AgencyProviderID splits ProviderListDept on '/', parses AgencyID and ProviderID.
AgencyDepartIDFormatted concatenates AgencyID and ProviderID with '/'.
AgencyDepartFormatted concatenates Agency and Department, substitutes ALL if Department is missing.
conditions: Alternate ProviderType field used if sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true.
Search by ID only runs if ID > 0.
system_behavior: Uses SQL stored procedures for form operations.
Adds error message to Sess.Messages if validation fails.
dependencies: Stored procedures: StaffConsentFormsSearch, StaffConsentFormsSearchID, StaffConsentFormsAdd, StaffConsentFormsUpdate, StaffConsentFormsDelete
exceptions: Validation failure when DateReceived is missing.
content_gaps: No details about UI or exact database schema.
No description of error handling for invalid ProviderListDept.
No business rules for other fields beyond DateReceived and ID.
